params.name: targetField
params.description: Field on which to execute the search

params.name: value
params.description: in: value to search for (may use the '@' wildcard); out: value found

overloads.semanticRole: Searches for the first record whose targetField equals value (supports the '@' wildcard), returning its record number, or -1 if none is found; on success, value is overwritten with the value found.

constraints: Because value is reassigned by the search (it is both an input search value and an output for the value found), you cannot pass a numbered parameter ($1, $2, etc.) as value -- this would cause malfunctions in compiled mode.
If value is itself a field, its value is reassigned when the query succeeds, so Modified record will return True for the current record afterward.
